gloss: little by little; gradually; bit by bit

definitions.gloss: little by little; gradually; bit by bit
definitions.explanation: Expresses gradual, incremental change or progress in small amounts at a time. Very common in everyday conversation for describing slow but steady improvement or change.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しずつ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}している→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧。
⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{少|すこ}しずつ⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: The weather has been gradually getting better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{少|すこ}しずつ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}すれば→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you practice a little bit every day, you will definitely get better.

notes:
Expresses gradual, incremental change or action. Formed from ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ (a little) + ⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (each/at a time). Very commonly used in everyday conversation and writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少|すこ}しずつ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change little by little
- {少|すこ}しずつ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance gradually
- {少|すこ}しずつ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to something gradually
- {少|すこ}しずつ⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get better little by little

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually — more formal and literary; often used in written Japanese
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧: gradually — emphasizes a noticeable progressive change over time
- ⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually — literary; implies steady, inevitable progression
